title: Company profile
description: The data the AI uses to find matching tenders.

completion.title: Profile completion
completion.complete: Your profile is complete. The AI has what it needs to find matching tenders.
completion.missing: Add these so the AI finds better matches:

company.title: Company
company.idnoHint: 13 digits. We look the company up in data2b.md.
company.name: Name

lookup.searching: Looking up the IDNO in data2b.md…
lookup.notFound: data2b.md has no company with this IDNO. Fill in the details yourself.
lookup.failed: data2b.md did not respond. Fill in the details yourself.
lookup.matches: The name and region in your profile match this record.

aiDescription.title: Description for the AI
aiDescription.label: What the company does
aiDescription.hint: Write what you sell, what services you offer and where you work. The AI reads this to pick matching tenders.

matching.title: Matching
matching.cpvHint: Format 30213000-5. You can paste several codes at once.
matching.regionsHint: Where you can deliver or work.
matching.budgetHint: Leave empty if you have no limit.

eligibility.title: Eligibility
eligibility.hint: We compare these with tender requirements, such as a minimum turnover.

errors.notWholeNumber: Enter a whole number, 0 or more.
errors.maxBelowMin: The maximum is lower than the minimum.

save.invalid: Fix the marked fields to save.
save.failed: The profile was not saved. Try again.

leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.description: Your changes to the profile will be lost.

pricelists.title: Pricelists
pricelists.formats: Excel, CSV or PDF. We read the products, services and prices from it.
pricelists.wrongType: {{file}} is not an Excel, CSV or PDF file.
pricelists.empty: You have not uploaded a pricelist yet.
pricelists.failed: The file could not be read
pricelists.deleteDescription_one: This deletes {{file}} and the {{count}} catalogue item read from it.
pricelists.deleteDescription_other: This deletes {{file}} and the {{count}} catalogue items read from it.
pricelists.deleteFailed: The pricelist was not deleted. Try again.

catalogue.title: Catalogue
catalogue.note: We keep only the name, description and price. Quantities are never stored, because stock changes.
catalogue.name: Name
catalogue.priceInvalid: Enter a price of 0 or more.
catalogue.saveFailed: The item was not saved. Try again.
catalogue.deleteFailed: The item was not deleted. Try again.
catalogue.emptyDescription: Upload a pricelist and we will read your products and services from it.
